about: Human obscurity judgments from experienced players. Ground truth for evaluating scoring; never fed to the ranking model.

rarest.note: Played as a carry, so players don't associate him with being tanky.
His gun is automatic and most people assume it's an AR.
A green (health-related) item should be rarest; Restorative Locket.
